content_of_post_to_answer: What free habits actually make you feel rich?
answer: One habit that makes me feel rich is using what I already own instead of constantly imagining what I need next. Cooking a simple meal, walking without headphones, repairing something, or enjoying an unplanned afternoon creates a quiet kind of abundance. I've explored this idea further in some of my other writing on my Quora profile. Wealth isn't only having more options; it's needing fewer things to feel satisfied.
